tagline: 佳能便携相机，2003 年发布
description: 佳能于2003年推出的便携相机。配备38–80 mm f/4.7–9.4 (6 elements in 6 groups, including an aspherical lens element)。快门速度1/480 ~ 2 sec.。感光度25–3200 ISO using DX coded film.。0.6 m to infinity (close-up mode: 0.45 m)。

specs.镜头: 38–80 mm f/4.7–9.4 (6 elements in 6 groups, including an aspherical lens element)
specs.闪光灯: Zooming flash, GN 10.6 (wide) to 12.5 (tele), flash range 0.6–3.8 m (wide); 0.6–2.2 m (tele). Recycles in 6 s. *Automatic fill flash, separate lamp for red eye reduction.
specs.英文简介: One of Canon's last 35 mm compact cameras, the Prima Zoom 80u (or Sure Shot 80u in America) from 2003 integrates a 2x zoom in a compact silver case.
